physical.title: Synthetic native finite Beam through complete circular Glass

interpretation.requestedResult: Observe genuine finite parallel native rays refracting through both boundaries of an explicitly authored homogeneous circular region, with sampled downstream detector crossings.
assumptions: The 2D finite circular region (radius 100 mm) with refractive indices 1 outside and 1.5 inside is an explicit synthetic teaching control, not an extracted JEE material or radius.
The parallel native Beam is explicitly authored at x=-160 mm, y=0 mm, width 20 mm, brightness 0.08, and rightward horizontal propagation.
The passive finite detector is explicitly authored at x=260 mm, centre y=0 mm, length 200 mm.
Fresnel partial reflection is explicitly disabled; native total internal reflection remains enabled.
unknowns: The original JEE J16 or J15 problem's sphere/bubble and single-surface facts do not determine this complete circular apparatus.
2D sampled detector crossings do not establish 3D apparent position, a physical image, continuous irradiance, or textbook-answer completeness.
